ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the job postings. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Supporting introduction shown below the heading. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Explore current opportunities to join our team.

JobPostings.helper: Add job postings in the order they should appear. Hidden postings remain available for later use.

ShowPosting.helper: Show this job posting to site visitors.

Summary.helper: Optional. Short summary shown near the top of the posting. HTML is allowed.

Department.helper: Optional. Team or department responsible for the role.

WorkplaceType.helper: Optional. Choose how the work is performed.

Location.helper: Optional. City, region, country, or other location description.

Responsibilities.helper: Optional. Describe the main responsibilities. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

Qualifications.helper: Optional. List required qualifications. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

PreferredQualifications.helper: Optional. List preferred qualifications. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

Compensation.helper: Optional. Provide a salary range, benefits summary, or a note such as ‘Not disclosed’.

PostedDate.helper: Optional. Date this posting was published.

DetailUrl.helper: Optional. Enter or select a local or external detail-page URL.
